demonstrations.coordinate_frame_convention: W is ID0 centre: +X decoded corner0 to corner1; +Y corner3 to corner0; +Z out of printed face. Standard41 corners reordered [1,0,3,2] for OpenCV IPPE. W_T_tag = inverse(C_T_W) @ C_T_tag. World ID1 is registered to ID0. World axes are not gravity-calibrated. Object centre = face centre minus edge/2 along outward tag Z; common object orientation is unspecified.
demonstrations.normalization: Start origin; longitudinal toward measured endpoint, lateral left, signed world Z; divide lengths by planar displacement. Missing rows preserved. No endpoint correction.
limitations: Motion timings do not measure grasp/contact.
Inherited landscape calibration/crop and world Z gravity direction remain unverified.
